public_rationale: The antecedent is unclear. Anthropic did not go public in September; it publicly filed its S-1 on October 26 (e1). That counts as rushing toward an IPO only under a broad reading. More importantly, the consequent cannot be measured. A 'brutal position of having to defend itself against both its own and Anthropic's economics' has no threshold, measure, or deadline, and no ordinary reading lets evidence clearly confirm or refute it. Early coverage compares the two companies (e2), but that cannot settle a characterization like this. The claim is not checkable as written.
limitations: Judging this claim uncheckable is itself a judgment call.
